newsitem.title: DUBAI: Fifth MPGC conference set for March in Abu Dhabi.
newsitem.headline: Fifth MPGC conference set for March in Abu Dhabi.

text.p: The fifth annual Middle East Petroleum and Gas Conference (MPGC) will be held in Abu Dhabi between March 2-4 1997, backers of the meeting said on Wednesday.
Next year's MPGC in the United Arab Emirates capital will centre on the theme "Middle East Oil in the 21st century: Emerging strengths and opportunities."
The conference will be held under the patronage of Yousef Omair Bin Yousef, Secretary General of Abu Dhabi's Supreme Petroleum Council and general manager of Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC).
Previous MPGCs have been held in Bahrain, Dubai and Oman.
